Question Choices: Select the correct description of the points (A,B). A:5,6,7,8,9; B:7,8,9,11,15. ~~Vertical-line | Horizontal-line | Slanted-straight-line | Not-a-straight-line~~
Hints: Equal x values give a vertical line; equal y values give a horizontal line. Otherwise, check whether the rate of change is constant.
Solution: Inputs rise by 1 each time, but outputs rise by 1,1,2,4. A straight slanted line requires a constant rise for equal horizontal steps. Neither coordinate is constant, and the rises differ, so the points are not all on one straight line.

Question Choices: Two sequences are related by the rule B = 14A - 14. How much does B increase when A increases by 1?
Hints: Compare B at A and A+1; the fixed added or subtracted amount cancels.
Solution: B(A+1)−B(A)=[14(A+1)−14]−[14 A−14]=14. The fixed subtraction cancels, leaving the multiplying coefficient 14.
